name: Atlan
summary: Send OpenLineage run events with Ogun facets to your Atlan tenant, authenticated with an Atlan API token.

fields.name: api_token
fields.label: API token
fields.help: Created in Atlan; sent as a bearer token. Store it with ogun secrets set.

settings.name: tenant
settings.label: Tenant
settings.help: The subdomain of your Atlan URL, as in mycompany.atlan.com.

settings.name: path
settings.label: OpenLineage path
settings.help: The OpenLineage intake path for your connection. Check the vendor documentation.

settings.name: namespace
settings.label: Namespace
settings.help: OpenLineage namespace for Ogun jobs and datasets.

notes: Ogun sends OpenLineage run events with Ogun facets for artifacts and windows, through an outbox (ADR 0012). The path has no default: check the vendor documentation. This build reaches http:// endpoints only, so Atlan's https needs a local TLS forwarder until O-05 open issue 1 is closed.
